<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2004|month=01|day=4|content=

* The [[Loya jirga (2003)|Loya jirga]] adopts a new [[2004 Constitution of Afghanistan|Constitution of Afghanistan]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/south_asia/3366455.stm|title=BBC NEWS - South Asia - Afghans endorse new constitution|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* A [[military court]] in [[Israel]] sentences five Israelis to one year in [[Prison|jail]] for [[Refusal to serve in the Israeli military|refusing to serve in the military]] because of Israel's occupation of the [[West Bank]] and [[Gaza Strip]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.commondreams.org/headlines04/0105-03.htm |title=Five Israeli Soldiers Jailed for conscientiously objecting to Gaza and West Bank occupation by Israeli troops |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120924101519/http://www.commondreams.org/headlines04/0105-03.htm |archive-date=2012-09-24 |url-status=dead }}</ref> (Compare [[conscientious objector]])
* [[Exploration of Mars]]:  American [[Mars]] probe "[[Mars Exploration Rover Mission|Spirit]]" mission is successful and is sending back images.  Spirit is alive after rolling to a stop on the surface of Mars; confirmed by [[NASA]]'s [[Deep Space Network]] ({{Nowrap|9:00 p.m.}} PST).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://marsrovers.nasa.gov/newsroom/pressreleases/20040104a.html |title=Press release on ''Spirit's'' Performance on Mars |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120923054102/http://marsrovers.nasa.gov/newsroom/pressreleases/20040104a.html |archive-date=2012-09-23 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Mikhail Saakashvili]] becomes president-elect of [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], following the [[Georgian presidential election, 2004|Presidential elections]]. He had been widely expected to win following the November 23, 2003, ousting of President [[Eduard Shevardnadze]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/europe/3367495.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Europe - Lawyer claims Georgia presidency|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* [[Bolivian Gas War]]: In a televised speech, [[Bolivia]]n President [[Carlos Mesa]] announces that a national referendum will be held on 28 March to resolve the issue of how Bolivia's large natural gas reserves will be exploited.<ref>[https://www.forbes.com/markets/newswire/2004/01/05/rtr1198107.html Forbes Article announcing a referendum, to be held March 28, to discuss the exploitation of Bolivia's Natural gas reserves]</ref>
* [[Britney Spears]] abruptly marries a childhood friend, [[Jason Allen Alexander]], in a [[Las Vegas Valley|Las Vegas]] wedding chapel at {{Nowrap|5:30 a.m.}}; by afternoon, the couple have arranged an annulment, which is expected to be made official when the courts reopen on Monday.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.globeandmail.com/servlet/story/RTGAM.20040104.wbrit0104_2/BNStory/Entertainment/ |title=Britney Spears' abrupt marriage and equally abrupt annulment |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081204134823/http://www.globeandmail.com/servlet/story/RTGAM.20040104.wbrit0104_2/BNStory/Entertainment/ |archive-date=2008-12-04 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
